title: REQ · PhaserToReactEvents declares a typed characterClick event
summary: The Phaser events file exposes characterClick with an { id: string } payload on the typed bus.
description: Context: events.ts defines PhaserToReactEvents with objectHover, objectClick and sceneReady. Desired behavior: add characterClick: { id: string } so emit and on are type-checked for it. Expected result: handlers subscribed to characterClick receive the payload. Why: React needs a typed NPC click signal distinct from object clicks.
acceptance_criteria: Given phaserToReact, When emit('characterClick', { id: 'boy' }) is called, Then a handler registered via on('characterClick') is called once with { id: 'boy' }.
Given the events file, When type-checked, Then characterClick payload is { id: string } and existing events are unchanged.
